title: fix(app-shell): lay the phone preview pill out above the composer, not over it (objectui#13068)
body:
Fixes #13068

Clause-②: no

## What changed

On a phone (`isMobile`, under 768 px), after a built app was previewed and the preview closed, `ChatPane` offered the preview again with a pill (`ai-chat-mobile-preview-open`, objectui#2481) drawn in a `pointer-events-none absolute inset-x-0 bottom-24` wrapper beside the chat column. At 390 px that box sat on the composer's first input line (101 by 35 px).

The pill is now a row of the composer's own area. `ChatPane` hands it to `ChatbotEnhanced` through the existing `promptHeaderSlot` (PR #13067, objectui#12978) together with the pending-drafts bar: pill above bar, both in flow above the input, so the conversation gives up the room instead. The absolute wrapper is gone; the pill keeps its look, its `data-testid` and its one tap to the full-screen preview.

Only `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` changes in source. No prop, export or published face of `ChatbotEnhanced` changes (`Clause-②: no`, as the claim declared).

### The shape of the slot content, and why

`promptHeaderSlot` renders its content in a `mb-2 flex empty:hidden` row. Three facts decide what `ChatPane` puts in it:

- That row is a horizontal flex row with no wrap, so a bare fragment would set the pill BESIDE the bar. Measured at 390 px the bar's sentence already loses 8 px (`scrollWidth` 248 against `clientWidth` 240); beside a 101 px pill it would keep about half. So the two are stacked in a column.
- `empty:hidden` reads the DOM: an always-present column would keep the row (and its 8 px margin) even when the bar renders nothing. So the column exists only while a preview is available on a phone (`canvasApp !== null && isMobile`). Otherwise the slot holds the bar alone, exactly as PR #13067 left it, and stays empty when the bar renders nothing.
- The column does not depend on whether the overlay is open, so opening and closing the preview never remounts the bar. A remount would reset its count (`usePendingDrafts` holds no response cache) and the bar would vanish until the ledger answered again. The bar is remounted once, when a preview first becomes available on a phone; while the overlay is open the column sits under the full-screen preview, unseen.

The PM's hypotheses, measured: H1 confirmed in source and in the browser (pill only under `canvasApp && isMobile` with the overlay closed; the card's box reproduced). H2 confirmed with the stacking above (the slot's row would set a bare fragment side by side). H3 confirmed: `useIsMobile` answers `innerWidth` under 768, and at desktop widths the canvas opens beside the chat and no pill renders; the desktop slot content is unchanged. H4 followed: the placement helpers were local to the objectui#12978 test, so they move to a shared helper beside both tests (the `__tests__` helper-module convention, e.g. `console/__tests__/preferenceFramework.ts`), which both import.

## Measured boxes (Acceptance 2)

Chromium headless, zh-CN, the rig of PR #13067 reused: the worktree's console Vite dev server serving the REAL full-page `AiChatPage`, or the REAL `ChatDockMobileSheet` (the dock's phone presentation, the one addition to that harness), with `fetch` stubbed in the page: one `build` agent, two turns plus an `apply_blueprint` result that drafted an app, and one draft (or none) in the drafts ledger. The driver taps the app card's 预览, closes the full-screen preview, reads, then taps the pill. "Before" writes `AiChatPage.tsx` of `main` `bc98626` over the fix (restored afterwards, proved by blob hash against HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). Boxes are left top right bottom, CSS px, 390 by 844 unless named.

**Control:** `before-fullpage-390-pill` reads the card's boxes exactly: pill 144 712 246 748, textarea 17 713 373 777, 101 by 35.

| reading | pill | bar | textarea | pill on textarea | pill on bar | first-line points on the input | placeholder / content width |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| full page, draft pending, before | 144 712 246 748 | 16 650 374 704 | 17 713 373 777 | 101 by 35 | 0 | 4 of 5 | 238 / 332 |
| full page, draft pending, after | 144 606 246 642 | 16 650 374 704 | 17 713 373 777 | **0** | 0 | 5 of 5 | 238 / 332 |
| full page, nothing pending, before | 144 712 246 748 | none | 17 713 373 777 | 101 by 35 | none | 4 of 5 | 238 / 332 |
| full page, nothing pending, after | 144 668 246 704 | none | 17 713 373 777 | **0** | none | 5 of 5 | 238 / 332 |
| dock sheet, draft pending, before | 144 712 246 748 | 16 650 374 704 | 17 713 373 777 | 101 by 35 | 0 | 4 of 5 | 238 / 332 |
| dock sheet, draft pending, after | 144 606 246 642 | 16 650 374 704 | 17 713 373 777 | **0** | 0 | 5 of 5 | 238 / 332 |
| full page 320 by 700, after | 109 462 211 498 | 16 506 304 560 | 17 569 303 633 | **0** | 0 | 5 of 5 | 238 / 262 |
| full page, no preview yet, after | none | 16 650 374 704 | 17 713 373 777 | none | none | 5 of 5 | 238 / 332 |
| full page 1280 by 900, after | none | 449 706 1121 760 | 450 769 1120 833 | none | none | 5 of 5 | 208 / 646 |

- **Before:** the pill covers the textarea's first line by 101 by 35 everywhere it shows; the middle first-line point reports the pill.
- **After:** the pill sits 8 px above the bar (642 to 650), or 9 px above the input when nothing is pending (704 to 713). It touches neither, all five first-line points reach the input, and the placeholder 「问问数据，或让我改改这个应用…」 fits whole. The textarea's box does not move: the conversation's bottom moves from 650 to 606 with the bar and from 712 to 668 without it. Tapping the pill opened the full-screen preview in every reading that has one.
- **Untouched states:** with no preview yet, the bar and textarea read exactly as PR #13067's `after-fullpage-390`; at 1280 (a preview opened beside the chat, then closed) they read exactly as its `after-fullpage-1280`, and no pill is drawn.

Before and after, full page, 390 px, with a draft pending:

![before, full page, 390](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/raw/2338aed682493be66d792e9496f3a06e668345c2/evidence/13068/before-fullpage-390-pill.png)
![after, full page, 390](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/raw/2338aed682493be66d792e9496f3a06e668345c2/evidence/13068/after-fullpage-390-pill.png)

After, nothing pending, and in the dock sheet:

![after, full page, 390, nothing pending](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/raw/2338aed682493be66d792e9496f3a06e668345c2/evidence/13068/after-fullpage-390-pill-nodraft.png)
![after, dock sheet, 390](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/raw/2338aed682493be66d792e9496f3a06e668345c2/evidence/13068/after-sheet-390-pill.png)

**Where the evidence lives:** commit `2338aed` of this branch, directory `evidence/13068/`: every screenshot (before and after), each reading as JSON, a README, the throwaway harness page and the Playwright driver. The next commit, `4086704`, deletes the directory, so this pull request's diff does not carry it (`git rev-parse 9c698ba^{tree} 4086704^{tree}` prints the same tree twice). No other branch was created.

## Tests (Acceptance 1)

- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.previewPillInFlow-13068.test.tsx` (new). Real full-page `AiChatPage`, real `ChatDockMobileSheet` default body, real `ChatPane`, `ChatbotEnhanced` and `PendingDraftsBar`, at `innerWidth` 390. The stand-ins are those of the objectui#12978 test, plus a handle beside the chat that calls the pane's `onPreviewDraftApp` (as a draft card's Preview does) and a Live Canvas reduced to its close button. happy-dom runs no layout, so the test pins the structure that decides the boxes: for the pill against the input, the bar against the input, and the pill against the bar, (1) the nearest element holding both holds no conversation (`role="log"`), (2) nothing between either and that element is out of flow (`absolute`, `fixed`, `sticky`, by class or inline style), (3) the first one's row comes before the other's, (4) neither sits inside the form. Cases: full page and dock sheet with a draft pending; full page with nothing pending; the pill opens the preview in one tap and closing it brings the pill back with the SAME bar node (no remount); at 1280 px no pill renders and the slot holds the bar alone.
- `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/inFlowPlacement.ts` (new, shared helper): the readings of the objectui#12978 test, moved out unchanged and generalized to any two elements.
- `AiChatPage.draftsBarInFlow-12978.test.tsx`: imports the helper instead of carrying its own copy; same four readings, same two cases.
- **Ablation 1:** fix committed, then `AiChatPage.tsx` of `bc98626` written over it (trap-guarded; anchor `promptHeaderSlot={promptHeaderRows}` 1 to 0 on disk, the float wrapper 0 to 1). The new suite went red, `Tests 3 failed | 2 passed (5)`: the three placement cases, each on exactly the old geometry (`holdsConversation: true`, `outOfFlow: ["div absolute"]`, `rowBeforeBelow: false`). The two that stayed green pin behaviour `main` already had (one tap to the preview, nothing at desktop). Restore proved by blob hash against HEAD and `git diff HEAD` reading 0 lines.
- **Mutation 2:** the column made to exist only while the pill shows (`mobilePreviewAvailable && !mobileCanvasOpen`, anchor 1 to 0 on disk). Only the one-tap case went red, `Tests 1 failed | 4 passed (5)`: after closing the preview the bar was gone (`Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="pending-drafts-bar"]`), the remount the column exists to avoid. Restored and proved the same way.
- Targeted run on head `4086704` (tree `a6aeeb5`, the same as `9c698ba`): `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/` plus the 58 test files under `packages/app-shell/src/layout/` and `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` that mount `ChatPane`, `AiChatPage`, `ChatDockPanel` or `ChatDockMobileSheet`: `Test Files 100 passed (100)`, `Tests 634 passed (634)`, exit 0. The full app-shell suite is CI's (`Test Core` shards).

## Gates (local subset; the farm is CI's)

Each exit code was captured to a file before any pipe; all on tree `a6aeeb5` (head `4086704`).

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint`: exit 0 (`0 errors`, warnings only; none on the changed lines or the new files).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0, after building the package's dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 28 tasks successful). A first run before that build exited 2 on unbuilt dependencies only (`TS2307 Cannot find module '@object-ui/fields'` and the like), a precondition, not a reading. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test, the shared helper and the edited objectui#12978 test.
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` 0 (`0 new citation(s)`), `pnpm check:control-bytes` 0, `pnpm check:vi-mock-specifiers` 0, `pnpm check:vi-mock-inherit` 0, `pnpm check:vi-mock-override-shape` 0, `pnpm check:test-path-roots` 0, `pnpm check:unreferenced-sources` 0, `pnpm check:changeset-claims` 0, `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` 0, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` 0 (`4 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)`), `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` 0.
- Changeset: `.changeset/13068-preview-pill-in-flow.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- At 390 px the pending-drafts bar's sentence 「有 1 项改动尚未发布——用户还看不到。」 is cut by its own `truncate` (`scrollWidth` 248 against `clientWidth` 240; at 320 px, 248 against 170), before and after this change alike: the bar's box is the same in both readings. Reported to the seat; not changed here.
- objectui#12725 is dispatched on the same file (the claim says so); whichever lands second merges `main`.
